gen-almendra-display-gf-anuphan: Storybook flourish up top: Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut, and its x-height stands tall over Anuphan's big round bowls. Anuphan stays clean and open in sans-serif, letting the ornate heading speak.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, its stroke ends set far apart and every stroke uniform in weight. Red Hat Display shares that constant line, bold and marker-like.
gen-almendra-display-gf-armata: Almendra Display's letters never seem to pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height that gives it an ornate, literary lean. Armata keeps plain sans text moving, with spacious gaps between characters.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-padyakke-expan: Padyakke Expanded One reads wide and slack, each c a pitcher mouth and its glyphs strung out like knots on a rope. Red Hat Display's marker line gives that literary serif a bold, contemporary neighbor.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-inika: Tight rows, strong voice: Oswald packs its lines close and confident. Inika's classic, traditional letters leave a see-through gap in each s, so paragraphs of text serif feel unhurried.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-stint-ultra-ex: Red Hat Display draws a constant, marker-like line with visible daylight inside every curve, bold and contemporary. Stint Ultra Expanded adds pipe-cleaner serif letters that float apart beneath it.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-amulya: Amulya leaves generous gaps in its curves, a modern sans-serif that feels light beside the bold heading. Red Hat Display, drawn like a neon tube, takes the louder voice.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-spline-sans: Marker-bold and sunlit: Red Hat Display draws daylight inside every curve. Spline Sans, an approachable sans, leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with vertical and horizontal strokes identical in weight.
gen-almendra-display-gf-biryani: Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. It excels at ornate, literary character, while Biryani, a sans, does plain clarity: a large eye on every e and uniform strokes.
gen-almendra-display-gf-carrois-gothic: Almendra Display never lets a letter pinch shut, ornate and literary. Carrois Gothic, a sans with a high x-height and a generous opening in c, keeps a modern, professional footing underneath.
